name: PHA bioplastics
principle: Polyhydroxyalkanoates are polyesters made by fermentation of plant oils or sugars with microbes. Danimer Scientific's Kentucky facility reached a run rate of 20 million pounds per year of Nodax PHA resins after debottlenecking in 2021.

source.note: Renewable Carbon News, Danimer Scientific completes debottlenecking of Kentucky facility, June 2021
